source.title: KDIGO 2026 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Anemia in Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD)
source.organization: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) Anemia Work Group

duplicate_review.finding: No duplicate formal guidance identifiers or canonical statements were found after semantic merge.

consistency_review.finding: Recommendation strength/certainty is preserved in tags; Practice Points are explicitly ungraded; underlying study results were not promoted to primary-study atoms.

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom AtomKind enumeration has no dedicated guideline_recommendation or practice_point kind. Formal guideline statements are serialized as atom_kind="other" with descriptive tags, following the large-source guideline guardrail.
extraction_limitations: Canonical statements were normalized from the PDF text layer to repair line-wrap hyphenation, ligatures, inequality symbols, and ferritin mass-per-volume symbols after visual verification.

The ATOM schema is oriented toward primary literature; this extraction captures the guideline’s formal assertions rather than treating evidence summarized from cited trials as if KDIGO generated those results.
All atoms remain needs_review because extraction was performed by a language model without human source verification.
